_meta.description: Long-range rifle marksman for iPhone & iPad. Second-focal-plane Christmas-tree reticle, real bullet drop out to 800 yards, walking 3D wildlife, Game Center matches, and iMessage challenges. Quiet, patient, classy.
a-3d-animal-target.184bd1: A 3D animal target in the scope on a sunlit range
a-long-range-marksman.13544d: A long-range marksman game for iPhone and iPad, with honest ballistics out to 800 yards.
a-second-focal-plane.54158b: A second-focal-plane scope with a Christmas-tree reticle, marked from 100 out to 800 yards. Tap the hash for your range and hold it on the target.
an-olympic-ring-target.50db41: An Olympic ring target on the range, with the distance and wind readouts
are-there-ads-iaps.46a41b: Are there ads, IAPs, or subscriptions?
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
how-do-i-read.1d682d: How do I read the Christmas-tree reticle?
iphone-and-ipad-on.ba556d: iPhone and iPad, on iOS 17 or later, with one purchase covering both. iPhone plays in portrait; on iPad it works in every orientation, including Split View and Stage Manager.
is-ridgeshot-available-in.5fc13e: Is Ridgeshot available in the European Union?
looking-through-the-scope.801f8b: Looking through the scope, the reticle's yardage hashes on a distant target
no-ads-no-tracking.b6dfd8: No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. Game Center relays online matches, and Ridgeshot collects no telemetry.
no-ridgeshot-is-a.e60b7b: No. Ridgeshot is a one-time purchase. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions. You get every range, every target, every weather state, both online flows, and all five leaderboards.
one-shot-one-breath.0f9f62: One shot. One breath. One ridgeline lit by the last hour of daylight.
open-a-conversation-in.69ee20: Open a conversation in Messages, tap the Ridgeshot iMessage app, pick a format (Quickfire / Classic / Long Course) and a target style (Olympic paper / 3D wildlife), then send. Your friend taps the bubble, takes a single round, and sends the updated bubble back. Each round is one bubble — like Wordle, but for marksmen. The match lives entirely in your thread.
past-300-yards-the.0693df: Past 300 yards the round falls, and the wind pushes it sideways. Read the flag, settle your breath, and break the shot between breaths.
send-a-match-through.a4aef5: Send a match through iMessage and your friend shoots inside the bubble. Or hand the phone across the couch, or find an opponent on Game Center.
shoot-olympic-rings-steel.eeab73: Shoot Olympic rings, steel plates and bottles, or 3D wildlife that walks the range. Animal targets unlock only after a one-time adult age check.
that-s-natural-sway.6ce413: That's natural sway — pulse, breath, fatigue, and a rifle that weighs more than your forearm. The longer you hold, the wider your reticle wanders. Break the shot at the natural pause between breaths, or wait, settle again, and try the next cycle. Snap-shooters can lift early for a quick break; precision shooters can hold longer for a tighter window if they trust their settle. Both work — pick your style.
the-christmas-tree-gives.073d27: The Christmas tree gives you yardage hashes from 100 out to 800. Tap the one that matches your range, place it on the heart or the X, and let the wind decide if you need to drift a little. That last decision is the whole game.
the-match-result-with.6e1f1e: The match result, with the winner on 30 points
the-ridgeshot-menu-with.a5dba0: The Ridgeshot menu, with target styles, match formats and ways to play
what-devices-does-it.b7b7b0: What devices does it run on?
why-does-my-reticle.ea9a33: Why does my reticle drift while I'm holding?
yes-pass-and-play.f31404: Yes — pass-and-play is fully offline. Two shooters, one device, no sign-in. Game Center matchmaking and iMessage challenges need a connection to relay turns, but the whole simulation — ballistics, wind, animals, weather — runs on-device.
yes-ridgeshot-is-on.cf0a86: Yes. Ridgeshot is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
